messages:
Marco (eng-platform): Heads-up — we need to add per-route "cold_start_ms" and p99/p995 tail-latency metrics for the routing policy rollout next week. These need to feed the runtime dashboards and the console rollout UX so product can show per-route regressions.
Tess (runtime): Got it. Is the expectation that the runtime emits those directly or do we want a sidecar/agent aggregator?
Marco (eng-platform): Prefer runtime emits direct export to our telemetry pipe (ktl-exporter). We discussed a lightweight histogram + labels: route, model_variant, region, tier. Concern: cardinality explosion for low-traffic routes.
Ravi (infra): Cardinality warning — storing raw histograms per route long-term will spike storage. Suggest sampling for routes below X qps and TTL-based retention tiers. For hot routes keep full retention, cold routes 7d aggregate then rollup.
Alex (product-telemetry): For the rollout UX we only need 7d/30d trends and alerts on sudden p99 regressions. If we can keep per-route raw 1h-resolution for 30d for top 2k routes, and daily-aggregates for others, that's fine.
Tess (runtime): Implementation plan: add metric name `rt_route_cold_start_ms` + `rt_route_latency_ms` histogram. We'll emit labels: `route=/<path>`, `variant`, `region`, `tier`. For sampling, runtime can set `telemetry.sample_rate=0.1` for routes with <1rps. Need a config hook from eng-platform to mark hot routes.
Marco (eng-platform): We have route affinity list from routing service. Can expose via `route-metadata` internal API. Question: should telemetry query that API or should router push a "hotlist" to exporter? Debate on internal contract.
Ravi (infra): Strong prefer push model — avoids telemetry making many lookups. Router can emit a small heartbeat to `/internal/hot-routes` and infra will update exporter config.
Alex (product-telemetry): Backfill: we need historical baselines for canary comparisons. If we don't have past `cold_start_ms`, we should run a backfill against logs for the last 90d but paced. Can infra run a throttled backfill job?
sre-oncall: +1 on throttling. Past backfills killed ingestion cluster. Suggest chunked backfill by route group with rate-limits and circuit breakers.
Tess (runtime): For export format, will use OpenMetrics-style histograms. Example snippet we'll emit from runtime:```
# metrics config
rt_route_latency_ms_bucket{route="/generate",variant="v2",region="us-west-2",le="50"} 123
rt_route_latency_ms_sum{...} 24500
rt_route_latency_ms_count{...} 900
```
Alex (product-telemetry): Nice. For aggregation jobs, product wants 1m -> 1h rollups and 1h -> 1d rollups. Retention tiers: raw 1m for 30d for top routes, 1h aggregates for 90d, 1d aggregates for 365d. Cold routes: raw 1m for 7d then only 1h for 30d.
Ravi (infra): We'll need exporter sampling config + aggregator config. I'll add a `ttl_policy` matrix in infra config repo. Also propose sampler that uses reservoir sampling per 5m window to maintain statistical validity for low volume routes.
Marco (eng-platform): Can we also tie per-route quotas into this? If route A is getting throttled, we should annotate the metric and exclude throttled tokens from latency calculations or at least mark them.
Tess (runtime): We can add label `throttled=true/false` on emit. That will increase cardinality again but it's binary so acceptable.
Alex (product-telemetry): For dashboard UX: product wants an option to toggle sampling-corrected view (estimates) vs raw counts so PMs understand noise. Also want alerting settings per-route with automatic suggested thresholds based on median baseline.
Marco (eng-platform): Action items: 1) Tess to PR runtime metric emit (schema + sampling hook) by EOD tomorrow. 2) Ravi to add TTL/sampler config proposal in infra repo and a backfill throttling playbook by Friday. 3) Alex to draft dashboard wire with sampling-corrected toggle and suggested alert thresholds. 4) I'll wire route hotlist push API design doc and schedule a 30m sync.
Tess (runtime): Will add `telemetry.sample_rate` plus `hotlist` toggle. PR will include CI test that simulates 10k routes to surface cardinality OOMs.
Ravi (infra): I'll spin up a small canary infra pipeline for export + rollup to validate cost. Expect cost for full retention naive to be ~3x.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: `ktl-exporter` config v2 will roll to canary at 02:00 UTC.
Marco (eng-platform): Perfect. One more thing — backfill window: Alex, can you prioritize routes for backfill? We should avoid trying to backfill thousands of one-off routes.
Alex (product-telemetry): I'll produce a prioritized list (top 2k by 30d traffic, plus 500 canary routes) and share before EOD.
Ravi (infra): Noted. Also adding a rate limit: backfill job <= 50 routes/hour for first 24h, auto-increase if ingestion stable.
Marco (eng-platform): Thanks all. Sync 30m calendar invite incoming. :thumbsup:
Tess (runtime): :thumbsup: Will start the PR now.
sre-oncall: I'll standby during the canary window. Ping me if alerts spike.
Alex (product-telemetry): Uploaded initial dashboard mock -> https://intranet.redwood/dashboards/draft/route-latency (comments open).
Marco (eng-platform): Closing the loop — aim to flip rollout guard to require these metrics before the routing policy gradual rollout.
